sources: UNCTAD (2023), The State of Commodity Dependence 2023 – 101 of 191 UNCTAD member states (52.9 %) were commodity-dependent in 2019–2021 (commodities > 60 % of merchandise export value); 95 of 142 developing countries (66.9 %).
